characters.summary: As Grand Master of the New Jedi Order, Luke Skywalker possesses mastery of both the physical lightsaber combat and the most profound realms of the Force, capable of projecting his consciousness across galaxies and manipulating immense cosmic energy.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to extreme physical exhaustion when utilizing massive Force techniques like long-range projection
Susceptibility to specialized Yuuzhan Vong biological weapons that create shadows in the Force
limitations: Massive Force feats drain his physical stamina and require deep meditative focus.
characters.formDifferences: Represents the absolute peak of Luke's power as the Grand Master of the New Jedi Order, featuring vastly expanded telekinetic power, mastery of obscure Force abilities, and wisdom far exceeding his younger days.

sources.supports: General background and development into Grand Master of the Jedi Order in the expanded universe.
Feats regarding Grand Master era abilities, Force projection, and mastery over multiple lightsaber forms.

feats.claim: Projected an illusionary duplicate of himself across the galaxy to face Darth Caedus.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Legacy of the Force - Inferno

feats.claim: Defeated numerous elite Yuuzhan Vong warriors and supreme leaders in combat.
feats.citation: Star Wars: The New Jedi Order series

campaignTags.claim: Advanced mastery of esoteric and rare Force techniques beyond standard telekinesis and telepathy.
Can communicate and project consciousness across interplanetary distances.
Demonstrated the ability to move massive starships and heavy objects with the Force.
Expert pilot capable of flying advanced starfighters and capital ships.

unknowns: Exact limits of his Force projection range without suffering catastrophic fatigue are not precisely quantified.

characters.summary: Mace Windu is a master of the Jedi High Council who utilizes Vaapad, a lightsaber combat form that channels his own inner darkness and opponent's dark side energy back at them, making him one of the deadliest duelists in history.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to sudden betrayal or overwhelming raw energy attacks if caught off guard
mobility: Standard foot speed enhanced by the Force
limitations: Vaapad runs the risk of drawing the user toward the dark side of the Force.

sources.supports: General character overview, status on the Jedi Council, and role in the prequel trilogy.
Details on Vaapad, Shatterpoint ability, and notable lightsaber combat feats.

feats.claim: Disarmed and defeated Darth Sidious in a lightsaber duel.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith

feats.claim: Crushed the chest plate of a super battle droid bare-handed using the Force.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Clone Wars (2003 TV series)

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith
notableResults.note: Won the duel before being intervened upon by Anakin Skywalker.

notableResults.note: Quickly dispatched Fett during the Battle of Geonosis.

Uses the Force for high-speed leaps and brief levitation.

unknowns: Whether he survived being thrown from the window by Palpatine in Canon remains a point of fan debate, though officially treated as deceased.

characters.summary: Maz Kanata is an ancient, wise smuggler and castle owner with vast underworld connections and a strong sensitivity to the Force, though she avoids direct physical combat whenever possible.
weaknesses: Physically frail due to advanced age and small stature
mobility: Relies on transport ships for travel
limitations: Lacks frontline combat capabilities without weapons or protection.

characters.summary: Migs Mayfeld is a cynical former Imperial sharpshooter turned mercenary who relies on quick wit, twin blaster pistols, and underworld savvy to survive dangerous heists.
weaknesses: Vulnerable in open melee combat against physically superior opponents
limitations: Relies entirely on standard physical equipment and firearms.

characters.summary: Moff Gideon is a ruthless and calculating former Imperial Security Bureau officer who commands remnants of the Galactic Empire, utilizing advanced Beskar armor, dark troopers, and strategic cunning to achieve his goals.
weaknesses: Overconfident in his technological supremacy and control over remnants
limitations: Lacks innate Force abilities, relying entirely on technology and weapons.

characters.summary: Mon Mothma is a brilliant political leader and diplomat who co-founded the Alliance to Restore the Republic, orchestrating political resistance against the Galactic Empire through diplomacy, rhetoric, and clandestine networks.
weaknesses: Lacks direct combat skills and physical self-defense training
mobility: Standard transport vessels and diplomatic cruisers
limitations: Entirely dependent on security personnel for physical protection in hostile zones.

characters.summary: Nien Nunb is a skilled Sullustan pilot and smuggler who served as co-pilot to Lando Calrissian during the Battle of Endor and later fought with the Resistance.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to close-quarters hand-to-hand combat without vehicle or weapon support
limitations: Relies on standard equipment and starfighters.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful telekinetic attacks if caught off balance by exceptional powerhouses
limitations: Struggles against opponents with overwhelming raw physical strength coupled with aggressive offense when caught in confined spaces without room for defense.

characters.summary: As a Force spirit, Obi-Wan Kenobi transcends physical limitations, existing as a luminous manifestation capable of dispensing cosmic wisdom, appearing at will, and remaining entirely immune to physical harm.

mechanisms: Incorporeal form (immune to physical and energy attacks)

weaknesses: Lacks physical form and cannot directly inflict physical damage or manipulate physical objects in the material world
mobility: Instantaneous spiritual appearance / teleportation across locations
limitations: Cannot engage in physical combat or use traditional Force powers like telekinesis on material objects.
characters.formDifferences: Changes Obi-Wan from a physical living combatant into an incorporeal spiritual entity that cannot fight physically but is entirely immune to physical damage.

sources.supports: Overview of Obi-Wan's post-mortem existence as a guide to Luke Skywalker.
Mechanics and capabilities of Jedi Force spirits in canon.

feats.claim: Appeared to Luke Skywalker on Dagobah and Hoth to offer guidance.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode V – The Empire Strikes Back

conditional.dependsOn: Attaining oneness with the Cosmic Force through specific Whills training

campaignTags.claim: Communicates directly into the minds of living Force sensitives across vast distances.

mobility: Climbing and crawling through tight spaces
